focus: Bolivian tax-benefit surface: RC-IVA and VAT under Ley 843, SIP pension contributions under Ley 065, Renta Dignidad, and the Juancito Pinto and Juana Azurduy CCTs.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Bolivia Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: BOLMOD
oracles.dataset: Encuesta de Hogares (EH) based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Bolivia. Policy years 2019-23. Report CR-BOLMOD-v2-1 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for BOLMOD BO systems before wiring. Validation frame: BOLMOD v2.1, policy years 2019-23.
